subject: Six Stones, one advancement
body:
You built the Gauntlet. Thanos needed two movies and a sad farm for that. Snap if you want, I'll grow back. Last time I regrew my legs they came in as baby legs first and I waddled around like a toddler in a leather onesie for a week, and before you ask, no, not everything was baby sized.

love, your favorite merc
